plugin_read_only: You do not have permission to change these settings. You can only view them.

settings.title: Social Login Settings
settings.description: Manage the signup, linking and retention policies of social login.

email_conflict_policy.label: Existing Member With Same Email
email_conflict_policy.hint: What to do when the social account email matches an existing member email.

options.verify_link: Link after confirming the existing account (recommended)
options.auto_link_verified: Link at once when the provider verified the email (caution: trusts the provider check as is)

extra_info_mode.label: Signup Extra Info Screen
extra_info_mode.hint: When to show the extra info screen on social signup.

options.when_missing: Only when required info is missing

webhook_unlink_policy.label: Provider Unlink Notice
webhook_unlink_policy.hint: What to do when the provider reports that the member removed the app connection.

two_factor_enabled.label: Two-Factor For Social Login
two_factor_enabled.hint: When off, even members with an authenticator app skip two-factor on social login.

allow_admin_social_login.label: Allow Administrators
allow_admin_social_login.hint: Allow members with an administrator role to sign in with a social account.

allow_unlink_last_method.label: Allow Unlinking Last Method
allow_unlink_last_method.hint: Allow a member without a password to remove their last social link. They can then only return through password reset.

revoke_on_unlink.label: Revoke Provider Access On Unlink
revoke_on_unlink.hint: Also revoke the app authorization at the provider when a member or administrator removes a link.

state_ttl_minutes.label: Sign-In Round Trip Lifetime (Minutes)
state_ttl_minutes.hint: The member must return from the provider within this time. 3 to 30.

pending_signup_ttl_minutes.label: Pending Signup Lifetime (Minutes)
pending_signup_ttl_minutes.hint: Time to finish the signup screen after the provider check. 5 to 120.

custom_provider_limit.label: Custom Provider Limit
custom_provider_limit.hint: Number of OIDC providers an administrator can add. 0 to 10.

profile_raw_retention_days.label: Raw Profile Retention (Days)
profile_raw_retention_days.hint: How long to keep the raw provider profile for troubleshooting. 0 keeps nothing. 0 to 90.

attempt_log_retention_days.label: Attempt Log Retention (Days)
attempt_log_retention_days.hint: How long to keep attempt records used by stats and diagnostics. 7 to 365.

webhook_event_retention_days.label: Webhook Log Retention (Days)
webhook_event_retention_days.hint: How long to keep provider notice records. 7 to 365.

signup_surge_threshold_per_hour.label: Signup Surge Threshold (Per Hour)
signup_surge_threshold_per_hour.hint: Notify administrators when this many members sign up through one provider within an hour. 0 disables the notice.

provider_failure_streak_threshold.label: Provider Failure Streak Threshold
provider_failure_streak_threshold.hint: Notify administrators when one provider fails this many times in a row. 0 disables the notice.
